This '''individual''' was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. They were a young [[Youngling/Legends|child]] with [[Color/Legends|grayish purple]] skin. Like all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] enslaved individuals of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], they were named after a letter in the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and had their letter [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on their face. The child was brood mates with [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]], [[Jenth (human)|Jenth]], and all five were among those who were used to power the machines of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species that ruled the Infinite Empire. Xesh's earliest memory was of him and the rest of the brood mates huddling together for warmth.<ref name="DOTJ 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was first shown in a flashback scene from [[Tau (individual)|Xesh's]] past in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1]]'', the first issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|The Prisoner of Bogan]]'' story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, though their [[Species/Legends|species]] cannot be identified.<ref name="DOTJ 6" /> Due to most of their face being covered by a hood, only the top of their [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] character they are named after, is seen; and there are three characters that fit the motif. Since the letter [[Xesh/Legends|Xesh]] (X) is taken by [[Tau (individual)|someone else]], their name must be either [[Besh/Legends|Besh]] (which translates as B) or [[Osk/Legends|Osk]] (which translates as O).
